mode: Offline deterministic demonstration, no live model call

checks.name: Source interpretation
checks.method: STEP unit declaration + OCCT normalization; explicit body and stationary-interface confirmation

checks.name: Mounting count
checks.method: All selected measured holes copied for every source instance

checks.name: Interface alignment
checks.method: SMLib closest-point samples at 3 bore depths and 12 angles; measured source-to-instance transform

checks.name: Bore clearance
checks.method: SMLib distance from axis to nearest native surface at three depths

checks.name: Contact footprint
checks.method: Source trimmed-face annulus samples and SMLib support ring samples (not full containment proof)

checks.name: Kernel validity: stock-0
checks.method: SMLib manifold + material census + positive volume

checks.name: Kernel validity: stock-1
checks.method: SMLib manifold + material census + positive volume

checks.name: Kernel validity: stock-2
checks.method: SMLib manifold + material census + positive volume

checks.name: Kernel validity: stock-3
checks.method: SMLib manifold + material census + positive volume

checks.name: Dimensional constraints
checks.method: Compiled stock extent, explicit thickness, gap and maximum width

checks.name: Hole edge distance
checks.method: Distance from bore wall to rectangular stock sides before access cuts

checks.name: Repeated source envelopes
checks.method: Non-overlap of conservative local source bounding boxes

checks.name: Finite access clearance
checks.method: No finite user-defined access volume supplied

checks.name: Surrounding attachment
checks.method: Clamp lands or drilled bench holes generated; surrounding equipment not imported

checks.name: Exact source collision
checks.method: OCCT source and SMLib fixture remain separate BRep domains
checks.measured: Only interfaces and analytic envelopes evaluated

checks.name: Operating performance
checks.method: No structural, thermal, fatigue, vibration or speed solver

checks.name: Export integrity
checks.method: Reopened SMLib USD BReps: manifold topology, body count, bounds ±0.01 mm and volume ±0.1%
